prompt: This watercolor illustration depicts a bustling construction site where soft edges blend with structural lines. On the far left, a worker in a yellow hard hat stands firmly, holding blueprints that are slightly curled at the corners. Next to him, a stack of red bricks sits neatly piled, their rough texture suggested by loose washes. A brown dog rests calmly beside the bricks, its tail tucked under its body. In the center foreground, a woman in an orange vest points toward a towering steel beam, her arm extended with purpose. The steel beam rises vertically, its metallic sheen captured through pale gray glazes. Leaning against this beam is a man in a blue shirt, his posture relaxed as he looks at the woman gesturing nearby. To the right of the beam, a cement mixer churns slowly, its drum rotating with a sense of heavy motion. A pile of wooden planks lies scattered near the mixer, some overlapping in a haphazard manner. Perched atop these planks is a black cat, observing the scene with wide, alert eyes. Behind the cat, a foreman in a white helmet holds a clipboard, his gaze fixed on the documents. Standing next to the foreman is a young apprentice in green overalls, who is handing a wrench to the foreman. The wrench gleams subtly, reflecting the ambient light. Further back, a crane looms in the distance, its long arm stretching across the sky. Beneath the crane, a truck with an open bed is parked, its tires dusty from the site. A ladder leans against the truck, reaching up toward the cargo area. Finally, a toolbox sits open on the ground near the ladder, revealing various tools inside. There is no safety netting visible anywhere in the scene. There is no heavy machinery smoke obscuring the background.
